# ShadCV

Portable React resume and Next.js website.

- Source and integration instructions: https://github.com/Hundemit/shadcv
- Product website: https://shadcv.de/
- Official personal demo: https://demo.shadcv.de/
- English demo: https://demo.shadcv.de/?lang=en

The resume is served at /. Replace Jan Hindemit’s demo data, portrait, legal notice and PDFs before publishing your own resume.
